# Felicia Nevin Real Estate

> Felicia Nevin is a licensed California real estate agent (CA DRE #01961050) with eXp Realty of California, Inc. (CA DRE #01878277). She helps people buy and sell homes in Sacramento, Placer, and El Dorado counties, including Sacramento, Roseville, Rocklin, Lincoln, Folsom, El Dorado Hills, Elk Grove, and Auburn, and works with trusted partner agents across the rest of California. Reaching out is free and carries no obligation. The way to contact her is the form at https://felicianevin.com/#start.

## Pages
- [Home](https://felicianevin.com/): home search, instant home value estimate, and contact form
- [Buy](https://felicianevin.com/buy/): live MLS home search and what to expect when buying
- [Sell](https://felicianevin.com/sell/): instant home value estimate, pricing reviews, and what to expect when selling
- [Resources](https://felicianevin.com/resources/): plain-language guides to buying and selling in California, closing costs, a glossary, and common questions
- [Trusted vendors](https://vendors.felicianevin.com): inspectors, contractors, stagers, and other service providers in the Sacramento region

## Facts
- Licensed in California only. Does not offer services for property outside California.
- California requires a written buyer representation agreement. For most buyers it lasts no more than three months at a time.
- County documentary transfer tax in Sacramento, Placer, and El Dorado counties is $1.10 per $1,000 of sale price. Some cities add their own.
- Content on the site is general information, not legal, tax, or financial advice.
